text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thank you for all your hard 
work this year! —Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night before the final day of summer 
camp. I attended the after-party for the 
staff and trainers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The distance between you and your 
Trainee...? Why bring that up all of a 
sudden?
choice_data_list: I'm not sure how much I should pry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't I become someone Win Variation 
can rely on outside of training as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's true, how far is someone in 
the position of Trainer really allowed to 
meddle in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to hear the opinions of other 
Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For me... things have been so-so 
so far, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She shares quite a lot of her private life 
with me. We even hang out together on our 
days off.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, pretty much. Lately, it feels 
like they're almost like a parent to me. 
Outside of training, they even give me 
advice on studying and romance~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After asking around, it turned out that 
surprisingly many Trainers were relied on 
for personal matters.
choice_data_list:
(Should I be closing the distance a little 
more...?)

(Should I close the distance a little 
more...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Win Variation isn't the type to 
rely on others makes it all the more 
reason to... As I pondered this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A veteran Trainer raised their hand 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Um. Speaking from experience—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
You should remember that being too close 
can sometimes have the opposite effect.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I once taught a student who was extremely 
introverted... a thoughtful, lone wolf 
type of girl.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I had similar concerns myself, so I tried 
increasing our interactions outside of 
training—

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It is quite embarrassing to admit, but... 
...I once forced them to speak about 
things they didn't want to, causing them 
undue stress.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: That's just one example, but anyway.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Not everyone wants their worries listened 
to and resolved.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
There are some girls who want to settle 
things on their own terms, you know?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it depends on the Umamusume. I 
must deepen my understanding and interact 
with them carefully...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After that, while out on a walk, I found 
myself reflecting on how Win Variation had 
looked during the summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You came up with training methods tailored 
just for me, and on top of that, before 
races you'd encourage me and pull me 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Did they show any signs of wanting 
someone to listen to them?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, she expressed gratitude for 
the current situation. It seemed like she 
considered her current state to be the 
best it could be. ...And yet—still—"
choice_data_list:
(...No, brooding over this alone won't get 
me anywhere!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Determined to ask her casually about it 
the next day, I fell asleep for the night.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be taking my leave! Please 
take care on your way back.
choice_data_list:
...Shion! I want to ask you one last 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: Who do you talk to when you're troubled?
Who do you talk to when you're troubled?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Worries? Hmm, well—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ... Depends on what it is, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried about your studies or 
school, maybe talk to your friends, or 
your parents...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I tell anyone everything, 
but... Ah, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I consult with Trainer about pretty much 
anything regarding training, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you really are so reliable. Hehe, 
thank you, always.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“—Oops, I'd better get going. See you at 
Tracen Academy!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Within her mind, there were clear 
categories, and I had been placed in my 
proper spot."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, as a Trainer, this is the 
most rewarding position I could be in. She 
didn't seem dissatisfied with it either."
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I was just worrying over nothing 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If solving the problem in a way that feels 
comfortable for her works out, then that's 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, getting too close might 
actually cause stress."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Doing everything I can from my position as 
a Trainer. Reaffirming that vow in my 
heart, the summer training camp came to a 
close.
